description: This PHP file defines the LanguageImportController class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages the preparation of data and UI components related to language import functionality, including validation of language status and setting up Vue.js components with necessary properties for language import actions.

classes.name: LanguageImportController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering the language import component with appropriate language data and ensuring language validity for import operations.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with language data if 'languageId' is provided in the request, validating its existence and status before setting up the import component.
